composition_narrative.how_parts_connect: A ground-level track is fixed across the driveway opening. The gate panel is a welded frame with top, mid, and bottom rails. Vertical pickets infill the frame; density increases below the mid-rail. The panel rolls on wheels captured by the track. When open, the panel slides parallel to the boundary fence or wall. Pillars define the clear opening width; automation adds a rack on the bottom rail and a motor drive.
composition_narrative.why_layout: Tracked sliding suits wide driveways where swing arcs are impractical. The mid-rail stiffens the panel and anchors decorative rows. Dense lower bars reduce gap at the base. Ground track carries weight compared to cantilever systems that need a counterweight tail.
distinctive_features: Single sliding leaf (not two swing leaves)
Mid-rail with optional second finial row
